source: Accepted HND-006..HND-009 clarification: decision loop primary, new_session/context_refresh same-agent context hygiene, handoff only transfer, CodeWiki orchestrates user-opened sessions.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from source refs and build handoffs, not prior loop chat memory.
evidence: new session id or recorded context reset

validation.reason: Fresh validation is preferred; policy may require it for high-risk semantic gates.

next_loop.reason: The next compiler loop should start from the build handoff, not the producing compiler context.
evidence: new session id or recorded context reset

requirements.text: Use decision loop for user semantic approval; use new_session/context_refresh for same-agent context hygiene; reserve handoff for transfer.
Agents may decide discretionary new_session/context_refresh when context is noisy, stale, or token-heavy, restarting from CodeWiki refs.
CodeWiki is the orchestration layer for all user-opened sessions through tasks, scopes, builds, validation, artifact status, wait/wake, and source refs.
Trigger policy distinguishes decision continuity, discretionary context hygiene, required validation proof, wait/wake resume, and true handoff transfer.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Decision-loop naming replaces feedback-loop as forward model.
evidence_mapping.evidence: compilers.md, change-lifecycle.md, lexicon.md, product/stories/intent.md, and skills/codewiki/SKILL.md now use decision-loop terminology with feedback/documentation compatibility notes.
compilers.md, graph.md, builds.md, validation-gateway.md, api.md, and adapters.md distinguish new_session/context_refresh from handoff and define discretionary agent use.
api.md, adapters.md, agency.md, product/users/agents.md, and lexicon.md describe session queue, wait/wake, scoped leases, builds, validation, and source refs as multi-session coordination state.

summary: Document decision loop and agent-owned new_session context hygiene
knowledge_changes: .codewiki/kb/system/change-lifecycle.md: decision loop replaces feedback-loop terminology; accepted rows compile into decision_build target or compatibility feedback/documentation builds; agents may run new_session/context_refresh for noisy/stale/token-heavy context.

.codewiki/kb/system/compilers.md: target flow begins with decision loop; compatibility feedback/documentation flow remains; compiler loop isolation is agent-owned context hygiene while validation gates keep proof requirements.
.codewiki/kb/system/api.md: vNext surface now distinguishes session_boundary from compatibility codewiki_session_handoff; new_session/context_refresh are same-agent hygiene; handoff means transfer.
.codewiki/kb/system/adapters.md: adapter capability now named session boundary control; Pi newSession documented as same-terminal replacement and not a tab/agent spawner.

.codewiki/kb/system/validation-gateway.md: context refresh policy allows decision loop to stay in-session and lets agents refresh when noisy; validation/task-close/publication still require fresh/content proof.
.codewiki/kb/system/graph.md and builds.md: graph/build policy changed from required compiler-loop handoff to agent-owned new_session/context_refresh guidance.

.codewiki/kb/product/users/agents.md, product/stories/intent.md, lexicon.md, system/knowledge.md, system/overview.md, system/agency.md: product/system language now frames CodeWiki as orchestration OS and decision loop as intent boundary.
roadmap_changes: TASK-006 scope/evidence now includes HND-006..HND-009 naming and context-boundary policy.
